text:
Maria (marketing): Quick sync 12 landing copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need final copy for the webinar slides and launch posts by EOD tomorrow.
Kev (growth): Do we have the benchmark narrative finalized? the micro-case that proves cost/latency win for hosted vs dedicated?
Nora (copywriter): I sketched three hero variations this morning. Short, benefit-led options for each mode. Will post links in a sec.
Ash (product): Important: messaging must call out routing & fallback behavior (how hosted falls back to dedicated/private when needed). Ops asked for one line about SLA differences.
Samir (webinar-host): For the webinar slide deck, I need a 1-line tagline + 2 bullets per mode (value, security, scale). Can we align on bullets now?
Maria (marketing): Proposed approach: 1) Hero focused on developer velocity for Hosted, 2) Predictable throughput for Dedicated, 3) Compliance & VPC control for Private. Then unified CTA: "Get started in minutes or request dedicated capacity". Thoughts?
Nora (copywriter): I like that. Shorten: Hosted: "Ship AI fast 12 hosted API, 30s to first token." Dedicated: "Throughput you can book 12 dedicated GPU pools and SLAs." Private: "Inference in your network 12 VPC & on-prem options."
Kev (growth): For launch posts we should have a benchmark snapshot: e.g., "Hosted: 60ms p95 @ 1k qps w/ batching; Dedicated: 30ms p95 reserved capacity" 12 is that accurate? Need to confirm with eng.
Ash (product): Those numbers are placeholders. Eng-runtime will confirm but call out relative ordering not raw numbers. Also add a line about cost controls: batching, quantization suggestions.
Maria (marketing): Action items: Nora finalizes hero + 2 bullets each. Kev drafts benchmark snapshot (placeholder numbers ok, labeled as "example"). Ash to confirm SLA language. Samir to lock webinar CTAs. Ops-bot: please publish staging landing with updated copy when ready.
ops-bot: Staging page created: https://staging.redwood-inference.com/tri-mode-landing (automated preview)
Nora (copywriter): Copy draft posted: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/tri-mode-landing 12 I left notes for CTA variants.
Samir (webinar-host): CTA plan: top CTA -> "Try Hosted API" (signup). Secondary CTA -> "Request Dedicated" (lead form). Private gets a contact-sales flow. Also add webinar UTM to CTA for measurement: `?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch`.
Kev (growth): Inbound routing: can we send Hosted signups straight to self-serve onboarding. Dedicated & Private leads should route to the sales queue in HubSpot with lead reason tags: `dedicated_request` / `private_request`. Kev will set up webhooks.
Ash (product): Confirming forms: Dedicated lead form needs expected TPS & monthly commit fields. Private form needs infra constraints + compliance checkbox.
Maria (marketing): Good. Nora, can you craft micro-copy for the Dedicated form field labels?
Nora (copywriter): Yep. Draft: "Expected throughput (req/s)", "Committed monthly GPU hours", "Data residency / compliance needs". Short help text under each.
Kev (growth): We'll trap leads with hidden field `landing_variant=tri_mode_webinar` for attribution. Also add `benchmark_snapshot=example_v1`.
Samir (webinar-host): For the webinar post, suggested social blurb: "New from Redwood: unified inference for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private 12 watch our live benchmarking + rollout playbook. RSVP -> link". Will write full post draft after deck locked.
Maria (marketing): OK timeline: Nora final copy by 3pm PT tomorrow. Kev benchmark draft + routing by EOD tomorrow. Ash confirm SLA and form fields by noon. Samir finalizes webinar CTAs and social blurbs by EOD. I'll compile into release checklist and tag everyone. :thumbsup:
Nora (copywriter): On it. I'll include microcopy + 2 headline A/B options.
Kev (growth): Adding HubSpot webhook config to the infra ticket: #INF-482.
Ash (product): Pinged eng-runtime for benchmark numbers 12 will update thread when they respond.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Publish staging landing with final copy" in 20h
Maria (marketing): Thanks team 12 small follow up: for the launch post we should highlight the cost-control levers (batching & caching) 12 makes the benchmark story actionable.
Nora (copywriter): Nice 12 I'll add a short explainer snippet under the benchmark callout: "How we lowered per-token cost: batching, KV caching, quantization profiles."
Samir (webinar-host): Perfect. Once Nora posts copy to Figma, I'll pull for slides.
Maria (marketing): Great. Closing this thread for now 12 will reopen if eng numbers change. :wave:
